Fetch OpenAlex journal metadata for the JCT journals

Source: R/bigquery.R
jn_fetch_openalex_sources.Rd

Downloads ISSN, ISSN-L, title and open access status of all OpenAlex sources with an ISSN-L, keeps the sources sharing an ISSN with a current or legacy JCT journal list, and writes them to openalex_sources.csv in raw_dir. jn_update_reference() then uses this file to assign ISSN-Ls and to classify journals as hybrid or fully open access.

Usage

jn_fetch_openalex_sources(raw_dir = "data-raw", config = jn_bq_config())

Arguments

raw_dir

Directory with jct_jn_all.csv.gz; the result is written here.

config

See jn_bq_config().

Value

The path to the written file, invisibly.

Details

The query reads only the small sources table (about 20 MB).
